import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Pull main
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git pull origin main 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("Pull:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check package.json for node version
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -5 /opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("\nPackage:", stdout.read().decode())

# Try build
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && pnpm install && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -20")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check dist
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js 2>&1")
print("\nDist:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
